summary: KEPCO filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its Board of Directors resolved on October 30, 2026 to contribute KRW 13.6 billion to the Korea Institute of Energy Technology (KENTECH). Combined with KRW 48.8 billion previously disclosed on March 30, 2026, total 2026 contributions are expected to reach KRW 62.4 billion, earmarked for construction of main facilities and 2026 operational expenses at KENTECH. No price per share, premium, advisor, or board recommendation on a transaction is stated; the report covers a routine corporate donation and is signed by Vice President Joo, Hwa-Sik. Not a special situation; no deal terms to watch.
